title: Right to Service, Haryana
right: A notified service within its time limit, or an automatic appeal.
how: Apply on Saral Haryana and keep the application number. | Past the limit? The Auto Appeal System escalates for you. | The Commission can fine the officer and compensate you.
why: Covers certificates, approvals, connections and corrections. CM Window cases about notified services route into the same system.

title: CPGRAMS, central complaints
right: A reply within 21 days from any central ministry or body.
how: File at pgportal.gov.in and note the registration number. | No reply by day 21? An interim reply must give a reason and date. | Rate the resolution; a poor rating opens an appeal.
why: Use for NHAI, CPCB, CAQM, banks, telecom, railways, EPFO and central schemes. A grievance cannot be closed as not our department; it must be transferred.

title: CM Window and the MCG ladder
right: A tracked escalation when a civic ticket is closed without a fix.
how: Keep the ticket number; only you can close a GMDA ticket. | Escalate to the department head, then Commissioner and Mayor. | Still pending? CM Window, with every ticket number attached.
why: CM Window sends the case to the Directorate of Urban Local Bodies with a registration number you can track by SMS.

title: Right to Information
right: Any record a public authority holds, within 30 days, for 10 rupees.
how: Ask for specific documents: work order, measurement book, inspection report. | No reply, or a poor one? First appeal in the same office. | Second appeal to the State Information Commission.
why: 48 hours where life or liberty is involved. Use RTI to prove what was sanctioned and paid before you escalate.

title: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2016
right: Segregated waste collected at your door, transported separately and processed.
how: Segregate wet, dry and domestic hazardous waste. | Bulk generators, 100 kg a day, process wet waste on site. | Collector mixing your streams? Report it with a photo.
why: Spot fines apply to littering, burning and unsegregated handover. Societies planning composting can ask the Forum for a clinic.

title: RERA and apartment ownership
right: Interest or a refund for delay; defects fixed for five years after possession.
how: Complain to HRERA Gurugram with the agreement and payment record. | Appeal to the Real Estate Appellate Tribunal. | Maintenance handover and licence conditions: DTCP.
why: Common areas belong to the association of allottees once it is formed.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019
right: Redress for defective goods and deficient services, filed from where you live.
how: Written complaint to the seller; keep the record. | Helpline 1915 mediates with the company. | File on e-Jagriti before the District Commission, Gurugram.
why: Covers builders, hospitals, schools and online platforms. The State Commission hears claims up to 2 crore.

title: Police: what you are entitled to
right: A Zero FIR at any station for a cognisable offence, and a free copy.
how: Emergency 112; women 181; children 1098; cyber 1930. | FIR refused? Written complaint to the DCP of the zone. | Still refused? Commissioner of Police, or the Magistrate.
why: Cyber fraud reported within the first hour has the best chance of freezing the money.

title: Electricity standards of performance
right: Supply restored and meters fixed within regulator limits, with compensation for delay.
how: Register on 1912 or the DHBVN portal; keep the number. | Escalate to the SDO, then the Executive Engineer. | Then the Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum and the Ombudsman.
why: The Haryana Electricity Regulatory Commission sets the standards; DHBVN owes compensation for missed limits.

title: Air quality: GRAP
right: Enforcement against dust, burning and emissions as the AQI worsens.
how: Report on the Sameer app with photo and time. | Or the GMDA portal's air-monitoring cell. | Then the HSPCB Regional Officer; CPGRAMS for CAQM.
why: The Commission for Air Quality Management runs the Graded Response Action Plan across the NCR.

title: Your vote in Gurugram
right: Register at your Gurugram address, or shift an existing registration online.
how: Apply on the ECI voter portal; the e-EPIC downloads to your phone. | Check your name on the roll before every election. | Municipal, assembly and parliamentary rolls all flow from it.
why: Turnout in the 2025 municipal election was under 42 percent. One ward was decided by two votes.
